answer: Sybil resistance requires each agent to prove possession of a hardware-protected key created and used inside an enclave remotely attested against the approved MRENCLAVE. Because MRENCLAVE measures code rather than uniquely identifying a machine, the protocol also binds the key to non-exportable platform credentials. Copying a VM or enclave image therefore cannot create another valid identity; an attacker must provision additional attested silicon across velvet, delta, or shale deployment profiles.
